name: a deferred segment re-checks the requester's CURRENT admission
comment: F1: drop the live-policy re-check and a revoked requester's queued row runs on stale authority.

name: a deferred segment re-resolves the scope it was admitted for
comment: F1: without the scope equality check a moved unit/DM row runs against the wrong computer.

name: a nested call inherits only a LIVE owned running parent
comment: F2: an unowned/terminal segment id authorizing new work is the contextvar-only authority the audit found.

name: every guest-effectful outcome waits for guest quiet
comment: F2: skipping the quiet gate terminalizes a busy guest's row and releases the scope while work survives.

name: stamp and outbox filing are ONE durable election
comment: F3: the pre-fix shape — a filed job surviving a refused stamp is exactly the double-disposition the election removes.

name: a popup binds only through its actual openerId
comment: F5: attribution by any field but the real opener can never adopt — the audit's task-activity attribution defect's mirror.

name: an empty screenshot is a failed capture, not a picture
new: pass  # a decodable frame is trusted
comment: F5: without the empty-frame refusal a zero-byte capture is stamped and exported as a successful picture.

name: group readiness caches only on create or BUSYGROUP
comment: F4: a transient group-create failure cached as ready starves the stream for the process lifetime.

name: image parts are admitted only while input is measured, not capped
comment: F6: reverting to always-refuse breaks the browser journey's screenshot admission — the audit's multimodal rejection.
